svg.text: Feilong (z/VM Cloud Connector) — Bring Your Own Database (BYODB)
High Level Design | 9 Phases Complete | 202 Tests Pass | Branch: byodb
✓ Each node has its own independent database
✓ compute_node_id stored in rows but NOT used for query filtering
✓ Zero config change required for existing deployments
✓ All nodes share one centralized database
✓ Rows scoped by compute_node_id — each node reads only its own rows
✓ FK constraints enforced ON DELETE CASCADE (remote mode only)
✓ Stale node detection via last_seen timeout — auto-marks inactive
✓ UPSERT on startup — register_compute_node() is idempotent
✓ image table uses sentinel compute_node_id='GLOBAL' (shared images)
Upgrade path: tools/migrate_sqlite_to_mariadb.py (idempotent — safe to re-run)
Firewall: allow TCP 3306 from compute node IPs only
rollback: set backend=sqlite in zvmsdk.conf and restart — no data loss
OpenStack nova.virt.zvm driver calls feilong REST API (transparent — no driver changes)
URL.create() — password percent-encoded, never in logs | dialect-agnostic SQL
compute_node_id Resolution (once at startup in get_engine())
Priority 2: vmcp query userid → "USERID@ZVM_SYSTEM" (z/VM guest only)
Priority 3: CONF.network.my_ip (always available — required=True config field)
Result stored in _COMPUTE_NODE_ID module global — all operators call get_compute_node_id()
id VARCHAR(64) PK <-- this IS compute_node_id
• Added to ALL 7 data tables as NOT NULL
• Forms composite PK with domain key (fcp_id, etc.)
• Local mode: stored but NOT used in query filtering
• Remote mode: FK enforced + _node_filter() on reads
• ON DELETE CASCADE from compute_nodes (remote only)
• Two nodes can hold same fcp_id — PK is composite
DATA TABLES (all 7 tables — with compute_node_id column highlighted in orange)
REMOTE MODE ONLY: FK constraints from all 7 tables → compute_nodes.id (added by migration 0004, no-op in local mode)
ALEMBIC MIGRATION CHAIN (auto-applied at startup via ensure_schema_current())
test_database(84) | test_remote_mode(12) | test_concurrent_startup(10) | test_migrate_tool(19) | test_hardening(18) | +8 more files
• SQLAlchemy Core 2.x — dialect abstraction (not ORM); preserves ~2600 lines of hand-written SQL
• Alembic — schema versioning; advisory lock for concurrent multi-node migration safety
• PyMySQL (pure Python) — no C extension; works on s390x IBM Z architecture
• _CompatRow wrapper — allows both row[0] (positional) and row['col'] (named) access on SQLAlchemy Row
• Deprecated: DATABASE_NETWORK, DATABASE_GUEST, DATABASE_IMAGE, DATABASE_FCP constants
• register_compute_node() uses UPSERT — idempotent on restart
• check_stale_nodes() swallows all exceptions — startup must not fail
• Pool event listeners track lifetime_checked_out / invalidated counters
config wins if set; env = fallback
• SOURCE_MAP: per-table column mapping with src_cols + tgt_cols (including compute_node_id)
• _inject_node_id(): stamps every migrated row with compute_node_id — image rows always get 'GLOBAL'
• Source SQLite files are NEVER modified — re-running with INSERT IGNORE skips already-migrated rows
✓ Default: backend=sqlite, mode=local — existing deployments need ZERO config changes
✓ SQLite path uses StaticPool — identical behavior to legacy sqlite3 single-connection pattern
✓ compute_node_id stored in all rows but local mode never uses it in WHERE clauses
✓ Rollback: set backend=sqlite in zvmsdk.conf and restart — source SQLite files untouched
